results.title: Pingwire - News & Resources
results.content: For small and mid-sized banks and payment firms, high false positive rates translated into cost pressure and customer friction; industry studies estimate that more than 95% of alerts in traditional systems are false positives, overwhelming teams and delaying true-risk decisions (**How AI is Revolutionizing AML Compliance)**. AI models have become a vital tool in preventing financial crime including money laundering and terrorist financing by supporting advanced AML efforts. AI-powered systems can also automate AML processes, reduce workload for compliance teams and improve efficiency. AI-powered systems can analyze transaction data to identify suspicious patterns and anomalies, focus on money laundering activities and alert compliance teams to potential money laundering activities. AI can also automate AML processes such as customer due diligence and transaction monitoring, reduce workload for compliance teams. * The future of AML will be more AI and machine learning to improve detection and reduce false positives, moving beyond traditional AML systems that rely on static, rule-based frameworks. * AI systems should be designed to enhance AML efforts, improving detection accuracy and reducing false positives.

results.title: A Pragmatic CDO's Field Guide to Data Quality — Part 10 ...
results.content: # **A Pragmatic CDO’s Field Guide to Data Quality — Part 10 — The CDO’s 12-Month Playbook: Operating Model, SLOs,** CoDQ**, and Change Management**. We define RACI at the CDE level, establish error budgets, incident response, and runbooks, and build a CoDQ (cost of poor data) model that rolls up to ROI. A maturity model with quarterly milestones guides progress. * **Capability Model Over Tools**: **Data quality (DQ)** initiatives succeed by focusing on core capabilities (**contracts**, **validation rules**, **observability**, **lineage**, **master data management (MDM)**, **reconciliation**, **privacy**, **ML quality**) rather than chasing shiny tools. This chapter presents a **DQ capability model** mapping each capability to concrete acceptance criteria, service-level objectives (SLOs), and evidence artifacts (like data quality scorecards and lineage…. ## Written by Adnan Masood, PhD. Dr. Adnan Masood is an Engineer, Thought Leader, Author, AI/ML PhD, Stanford Scholar, Harvard Alum, Microsoft Regional Director, and STEM Robotics Coach.
